text:
Sam: Morning — quick sprint status for the serving runtime milestone. Goal: kernel throughput +12% and KV cache warmup fix by Friday. High-level blockers: KV warmup regression seen in canary, microbatch PR (#482) waiting on perf review, and an infra dependency for larger seq-len tests.

Priya: I can own the KV warmup regression. I reproduced on canary (same input traces) — looks like an edge case when warmup triggers with sparse prefixes. Will push a diagnostic patch later today. :wrench: 

Evan: On #482 (microbatch scheduling) — left comments on the allocator path. Main perf delta comes from the new coalescing loop. I can drop a smaller perf-focused patch to reduce changes for the reviewer. @Marta can you spare a look after infra runs the longer seq-len job? :eyes: 

Marta: I can run the seq-len soak on the staging cluster at 11:30 PT. Heads up: eng-infra changed the test image tag yesterday, so I need to rebase the job config. ETA ~2h.

Sam: Thanks. Priya — ping when you have the diagnostic patch so we can run A/B on canary. Evan — if you can split the microbatch change into two PRs (scheduler + docs), that should speed review.

Priya: Patch pushed: `fix/kv-warmup-sparse-prefix-444` — includes extra logging and a toggle flag `runtime.kv.warmup_sparse_fix`. Please do canary with toggle=false -> true sequence. ci-bot: can you run canary with that flag enabled?

ci-bot: CI job queued: `runtime-canary-warmup/4444447800-1`. Link: https://ci.redwood.internal/job/4444447800-1 (logs will post here).

Evan: Re: PR split — done. New PR #483 is scheduler-only and much smaller. Left a note referencing #482.

Marta: Staging soak started. I'll post results here when the 6h run completes. If we see the same tail latency bump, we should consider enabling the toggle temporarily for canary traffic to validate correctness under load.

Sam: Plan for next 48h: (1) Priya deploys patch to canary + run A/B; (2) Marta completes soak and posts tail-latency numbers; (3) Evan lands scheduler PR if perf looks stable; (4) I'll coordinate rollback policy and owner handover for Friday's lift-off. If anyone needs to reassign ownership, say so now. :calendar: 

Priya: Acknowledged. I'll also add a small regression unit test to cover the sparse-prefix path.

Evan: I'll queue a perf replay with the smaller scheduler PR after Marta's soak.

Marta: Will share metrics (p50/p95/p99 + token throughput) in this thread once finished.

Sam: Great — thanks team. If nothing else, I'll do a mid-day ping tomorrow. :thumbsup:
